Real gap, but it fails closed: a fix of a finding reported on a since-rewritten commit cannot pass rule (a), and rule (b) needs the bot slot to need a substitute, so while the bot covers the PR only a reclassification clears it. Nothing unsafe merges; tracked as a follow-up issue (https://github.com/magora-project/magora-portal/issues/94).

Accepted limitation, spec §5.6 (David, 2026-11-03): a fix that a later commit reverts can still pass. Here the revert passes through a substitute chain carrying an earlier fixed disposition. It needs a revert plus a re-report under the same outside-diff marker plus a later CodeRabbit failure. A fix (5df29d8, reverted) broke the rebase escape for fresh substitutes (Codex P2), so it is deferred with #94.
